metadata.title: My Husband's Fake VIP Suite
metadata.subtitle: My husband threw me out of his birthday gala for wearing a $20 dress—not knowing my trust owns his startup AND the tower.

nodes.text: 7:45 PM · SkyCrown Tower, Floor 58. You arrive carrying a handmade birthday box for Lucas—only for his mother to yank you back from the velvet rope.
Are you insane wearing a $20 cotton dress here?! The anonymous investor backing Lucas’s $15M Series B is coming tonight!
Mom, I just finished a shift at the clinic. Lucas told me to come straight here.
I changed my mind, {{player_name}}. Go home. If the billionaire investor sees a frumpy wife, he’ll pull my funding.
Besides, Victoria is posing as my date tonight—her dad knows the SkyCrown owner.

nodes.prompt: Helen slaps your gift box onto the marble floor:

options.label: Pick up the box & smile coldly
options.player_reply_text: Funny—you’re kicking out the very person paying for this room.

options.label: Text Maya to cancel his Series B wire

nodes.text: Helen scoffs and snaps her fingers at the bouncer to escort you to the service elevator.
Delusional! You couldn’t afford the ice cubes in this suite!
You tap one line to your trust counsel. Within 5 seconds, Lucas’s startup bank app flashes crimson.
Copy that, {{player_name}}. Placing an instant hold on the $15M Series B wire.
Through the glass partition, you see Lucas sliding a diamond bracelet onto another woman’s wrist—inside the suite registered to YOUR name.
Your black gown and Sovereign Pass are waiting in the private elevator, {{player_name}}. Ready to walk in as the real investor?

nodes.headline: The Uninvited Owner
nodes.teaser_text: Lucas thinks his anonymous billionaire backer is arriving in ten minutes—he has no idea she was just shoved into the hallway.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Inside the private executive lift, you change into a midnight-silk gown while Maya calls.
Maya speaks briskly: "Wait till you see this—Lucas didn’t just book the suite. He forged a $400K invoice to your family trust!"
Encrypted voicemail transcribes instantly: "Lucas billed $400K of luxury gifts to your trust using a fake corporate stamp."
He bought his mistress a diamond bracelet with MY money? Send me the suite access log now.

nodes.caption: SkyCrown Owner Pass #001 — overrides every VIP suite lock on Floor 58.

nodes.prompt: Lucas is about to make his birthday toast on stage:

options.label: Walk straight through the VIP double doors
options.player_reply_text: Let’s see how loud he brags when the real owner walks in.

options.label: Cut the ballroom music & spotlight yourself

nodes.text: You swipe Owner Pass #001. The golden doors part silently as every investor turns to stare.
Excuse me—wait... {{player_name}}?! How the hell did you sneak past security?!
The jazz band stops mid-note. A blinding white spotlight locks onto you as the PA announces: "Please welcome the Sole Trustee of Apex Capital!"
Impossible!! The MC made a mistake! She’s just my son’s broke nurse wife!
You step onto the stage, take the microphone from Lucas’s frozen hand, and hold up your Sovereign Pass.
Happy birthday, Lucas. Ready to explain why you billed $400,000 in fake expenses to my trust?

nodes.headline: Toast Turned Trial
nodes.teaser_text: Lucas tries to laugh it off as a "marital joke"—until Maya steps forward with a red-stamped audit.

nodes.text: 8:12 PM · Cameras flash wildly. Lucas grabs your wrist, his voice dropping to a frantic hiss.
Stop this right now, {{player_name}}! Play along for ten minutes and I’ll dump Victoria tonight—I swear!
Take your hand off me, Lucas. You didn’t just cheat—you stole from my fund.

nodes.transcript: [shouting at guests] "Don’t listen to her! Under marriage law, half of her trust belongs to my son anyway!"

nodes.text: Wait till Helen hears about the prenuptial firewall you signed three years ago.

nodes.prompt: Helen lunges to snatch the audit folder from Maya:

options.label: Read the prenuptial clause aloud on mic
options.player_reply_text: Actually, Mom, every dollar is in an irrevocable pre-marital trust.

options.label: Project his divorce papers on the LED wall

nodes.text: The crowd erupts in gasps as you cite the infidelity forfeiture clause—leaving Lucas with zero equity.
Zero equity?! Wait—I built that startup from scratch!
The 20-foot screen illuminates with stamped divorce papers and a $15M loan recall notice due in 24 hours.
Served in front of 200 witnesses, Lucas. Sign at the bottom.
Lucas’s pale face suddenly twists into a desperate smirk as Helen whispers something sharp in his ear.
Fine! Take your money! But Lucas is the sole biological heir to your late father’s partner—the board still owes him 30%!

nodes.headline: The Heritage Gambit
nodes.teaser_text: Helen just dropped a shocking bloodline claim—one that could force the board to hand Lucas a third of your empire.

nodes.text: 8:25 PM · Senior board members murmur uneasily. Helen brandishes a yellowed birth certificate.
That’s why I pushed Lucas to marry you in the first place! Now give him his 30% founder share or we sue tonight!
You only married me to get close to my father’s founding trust? Every single word for three years was a lie.
{{player_name}}, stay calm. Remember the sealed medical file your father left in the vault? I just decrypted it.
Mom, are you sure that birth certificate will hold up if they run a lab test?

nodes.prompt: Helen demands a board vote right now:

options.label: Demand a live DNA verification
options.player_reply_text: A yellowed paper proves nothing. Let’s check the genetics.

options.label: Open your father’s sealed medical file

nodes.text: Helen’s smile twitches. She clutches her purse tighter as Maya pulls out a certified lab packet.
Conveniently, our forensic lab already compared Lucas’s sample from last year’s executive physical.
You break the wax seal. Inside is a hospital affidavit dated the exact week Lucas was born.
Your father’s late partner was medically sterile after an accident two years BEFORE Lucas was born!
The ballroom goes dead silent. Lucas slowly turns his head toward his mother in horror.
Mom... wait... if he wasn’t my father, then who the hell is?!

nodes.headline: The Lab Envelope
nodes.teaser_text: Maya opens the certified DNA report—and the 0.0% match is only the beginning of Helen’s secret.

nodes.text: 8:36 PM · Maya holds the lab report under the overhead camera so every board member can read the bold red verdict.
DNA probability of paternity: 0.00%. Helen forged the hospital registry thirty years ago.
All those years you called me a gold-digger, Helen—you were the one running a thirty-year con.

nodes.caption: Certified forensic DNA report: 0.00% paternity match — forged heir claim disproven.

nodes.text: Lucas, run to the car! Don’t let them question me about the forged deed!

nodes.prompt: Helen tries to bolt for the service stairs:

options.label: Have security hold her for the police
options.player_reply_text: Going somewhere, Helen? Identity fraud is a felony.

options.label: Ask who her accomplice in the clinic was

nodes.text: Two SkyCrown guards step smoothly across the doorway, blocking Helen’s exit.
Don’t touch me! Lucas, do something! Tell them you knew nothing!
You lean into the mic and ask how a receptionist got an executive hospital stamp—and Helen’s eyes dart straight to Victoria’s father in the front row!
Oh my god... Victoria’s father was the hospital administrator thirty years ago—and he’s Lucas’s real father!!
Victoria screams and drops her champagne glass as the horrified realization ripples across the entire ballroom.
WAIT A SECOND... Victoria is my HALF-SISTER?! Mom, what did you DO?!

nodes.headline: The Ultimate Scandal
nodes.teaser_text: Lucas’s glamorous "new girlfriend" turns out to be his secret half-sister—and every tabloid camera caught it live.

nodes.text: 9:05 PM · Outside SkyCrown Tower, torrential rain pours as police cruisers escort Helen away in handcuffs.
Lucas sobs through the static: "{{player_name}}, my startup is frozen, investors pulled out, and I have nowhere to sleep!"
Voicemail transcribes in frantic fragments: "Please don’t enforce the $15M recall... I’ll sign the divorce tonight..."
You told me to crawl home in my $20 dress two hours ago, Lucas. Remember how that felt?

nodes.transcript: [crisp and victorious] "His startup’s IP just transferred cleanly to Apex Capital to cover the $400K fraud plus penalties."

nodes.prompt: Lucas sends the signed divorce decree from the lobby:

options.label: Countersign & end the marriage cleanly
options.player_reply_text: Signed. Never contact me or my trust again.

options.label: Leave him his $20 dress receipt in the file

nodes.text: You press your digital signature onto the decree. Three years of quiet sacrifice dissolve in one tap.
Divorce finalized and filed. You’re 100% free, {{player_name}}.
You attach the receipt for your $20 cotton dress to the asset settlement—the only thing Lucas gets to keep.
You’re ruthless, {{player_name}}... I really lost everything tonight.
As you step back into the penthouse suite, the rain clears and the city lights reflect off the glass.
One last surprise: the board voted to rename the tower’s charity wing after your late father.

nodes.headline: Dawn Over SkyCrown
nodes.teaser_text: Tomorrow morning you wake up as the undisputed Sovereign of SkyCrown Tower—with one final toast waiting.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · SkyCrown Penthouse. Sunlight floods the marble floor as your phone buzzes with congratulatory messages from every major fund.
Morning, Boss! Apex Capital’s valuation just jumped $40M overnight. Ready for your first public keynote?
Ready. And tell the clinic I’m donating $5M to build a free women’s wing—no strings attached.

nodes.transcript: [laughing brightly] "By the way, are you wearing silk today, or the legendary $20 cotton dress?"

nodes.text: I saw your interview on the lobby screen... I was a fool.

nodes.prompt: How do you step onto the keynote stage?

options.label: Wear the tailored ivory power suit
options.player_reply_text: Ivory suit. New era, new crown.

options.label: Wear the $20 dress & own the headlines

nodes.text: Applause thunders across the auditorium as you step to the podium, radiant and untouchable.
Never shrink yourself to make someone else feel tall.
You walk out in the $20 cotton dress paired with a $2M diamond watch. Every camera flashes in awe.
#1 trending nationwide in 3 minutes! Absolute legend, {{player_name}}!
The doors of SkyCrown open to a brand-new chapter—built entirely on your own terms.
To the real billionaire of SkyCrown—welcome to the top, {{player_name}}!

nodes.headline: Act 2 · The Frozen Reserve
nodes.teaser_text: Before your victory champagne settles, Maya’s tablet flashes crimson—a hidden proxy just froze SkyCrown’s $400M trust reserve using a mysterious Second Beneficiary codicil!

nodes.text: 10:30 AM · SkyCrown Penthouse Study. Morning light turns tense as Maya spreads an emergency trust-bank freeze order across the marble desk.
Someone activated a dead-man’s-switch codicil thirty minutes after Helen’s arrest—freezing SkyCrown’s $400M operating reserve!

nodes.caption: Unsealed Trust Codicil claiming a "Guardian Proxy" holds a 40% veto share over SkyCrown Tower.

nodes.text: My grandfather trusted NOBODY outside our bloodline with SkyCrown. And notice the seal—it’s stamped with his old family signet, which went missing ten years ago!
Worse—someone just posted $500,000 cash bail for Lucas at the courthouse. He’s already walking free!

nodes.prompt: SkyCrown’s trust bank gives you 48 hours to disprove the codicil:

options.label: Audit every former SkyCrown staffer
options.player_reply_text: Pull the personnel files of everyone who worked in my grandfather’s study ten years ago—who could have stolen his signet ring?

options.label: Upgrade Floor 58 vault biometric locks
options.player_reply_text: If they want my grandfather’s original will inside the Floor 58 vault, add a silent thermal camera and biometric tripwire tonight!

nodes.text: Found a red flag! Grandfather’s former head butler resigned abruptly the exact week the ring vanished—and later worked for Helen!
Done! Silent thermal feed is routed straight to your phone—nobody can even breathe near Floor 58 without tripping our alarm!
Hours later, thunder rolls across the skyline—and a smug text from Lucas pings your screen right before midnight.
Hope you enjoyed sleeping in MY penthouse for one night, {{player_name}}. Pack your clinic scrubs—tomorrow I’m taking the keys back.

nodes.headline: Out On Bail
nodes.teaser_text: Minutes after Lucas’s threat, the silent Floor 58 vault alarm trips in the dead of night.

nodes.text: 1:55 AM · Rain lashes the glass facade of SkyCrown Tower as Maya’s emergency security line rings violently.
The Floor 58 biometric vault sensor just tripped—AND someone looped the main lobby CCTV to show an empty corridor!

nodes.transcript: [urgent voicemail] "Wake up! Floor 58 vault alarm tripped two minutes ago and someone wiped the main corridor cameras—checking thermal backup now!"

nodes.text: Don’t trigger the loud siren yet! If they looped the main cameras, they must have an insider’s executive override code.
Pulling the hallway feed right now—look at this eerie empty corridor they fed to the front desk!

nodes.prompt: Someone is inside your tower wiping security feeds at 2 AM:

options.label: Lock down all express elevators silently
options.player_reply_text: Freeze the Floor 58 express lifts and send two trusted guards up the service stairs right now!

options.label: Trace which terminal looped the camera
options.player_reply_text: Check the network log—which executive badge authorized that camera loop at 1:54 AM?

nodes.text: Guards reached the landing! The intruder barely escaped down the laundry chute—and dropped a silver cufflink engraved with a Butler’s crest!
Gotcha! It was an old legacy maintenance credential that belonged to your grandfather’s former head butler—never deactivated ten years ago!
You stare at the looped corridor footage on your phone—cold proof that Helen’s 30-year con had an accomplice inside SkyCrown’s walls all along.
Check the vault inventory immediately, Maya. Did they manage to open grandfather’s inner steel box?

nodes.headline: The Looped Corridor
nodes.teaser_text: The empty hallway camera hides a terrifying clue—and tomorrow morning, Lucas struts back into SkyCrown lobby thinking he’s already won.

nodes.text: 2:15 AM · Floor 58 Security Room. You compare the faked front-desk feed against the raw network timestamps.

nodes.caption: Tampered Floor 58 CCTV feed: frozen static frame looped by a legacy butler override key at 1:54 AM.

nodes.text: Good news: your biometric lock held! Grandfather’s original will is untouched—they only wanted to swap it before the Trust Bank audit!
Which means they’re desperate. They KNOW their forged codicil will fail a side-by-side comparison with grandfather’s real biometric will.
Damn it, the old butler couldn’t crack the vault! Whatever—we’ll still serve her the eviction notice at 10 AM in front of the press!

nodes.prompt: Lucas plans to stage a press ambush in your own lobby at 10 AM:

options.label: Let him walk in & record his fake notice
options.player_reply_text: Don’t block him at the velvet rope this time. Let Lucas bring every tabloid camera into the lobby—I’ll greet him personally.

options.label: Alert Trust Bank of the 2 AM break-in
options.player_reply_text: Send this looped CCTV frame and the legacy butler override log to the Trust Bank director tonight—put them on high alert!

nodes.text: Oh, I love this! I’ll have the auction-house antique alert running overnight to track down grandfather’s stolen signet ring too!
Trust Bank director just confirmed: he’s freezing ALL outbound codicil transfers until an emergency forensic hearing!
Morning breaks bright and crisp over SkyCrown Tower—just as a rented white limousine pulls up to the marble entrance.
Showtime, {{player_name}}! Lucas just stepped out with five hired reporters and a fake eviction folder!

nodes.headline: Lucas’s Smug Return
nodes.teaser_text: Out on bail and dripping in borrowed arrogance, Lucas tries to evict the real owner of SkyCrown on live camera.

nodes.text: 10:02 AM · SkyCrown Main Lobby. Sunlight streams across the gold marble as Lucas struts past the velvet rope waving a red-bordered notice.
Film this, everyone! The Guardian Proxy just appointed ME acting manager of SkyCrown’s 40% veto block! {{player_name}}, hand over the Floor 58 keycard!
You’re out on bail for inheritance fraud, Lucas, and you’re waving a photocopy stamped with a stolen ring. Do you really want to go back to jail before lunch?
Prove it’s stolen! The notary already certified it—and the Trust Bank releases our $160M share at 3:00 PM today!
WAIT A SECOND! My antique-registry alert just hit! Someone tried to pawn your grandfather’s REAL gold signet ring twenty minutes ago—and the CCTV caught the former butler’s face!

nodes.prompt: Reporters hold microphones inches from your face:

options.label: Expose Lucas’s bail conditions live
options.player_reply_text: Since Lucas invited the press, let’s read his bail order aloud: he is legally barred from stepping within 500 feet of SkyCrown Tower!

options.label: Send Maya to seize the pawned signet ring
options.player_reply_text: Maya, grab economic police and recover my grandfather’s signet ring from that pawnshop right now—before the butler realizes he’s spotted!

nodes.text: Uh—my lawyer said a business proxy overrides that! Don’t touch me, security!
Got the ring in an evidence bag AND the pawnshop slip signed by the former butler—dated THIS MORNING!
Security politely escorts a sputtering Lucas back outside the velvet rope—while Maya races up to Floor 58 with the recovered heirloom.
{{player_name}}, look under the magnifying glass at the inside of grandfather’s ring—there’s a microscopic date code that blows Helen’s entire con wide open!

nodes.headline: Mid-Season Twist · The Stolen Signet
nodes.teaser_text: The recovered family ring doesn’t just expose the butler—it proves the forged codicil was stamped AFTER your grandfather’s death.

nodes.text: 10:45 AM · Floor 58 Forensic Table. Under bright desk lamps, your grandfather’s gold signet gleams beside a crystal-clear forensic scan.

nodes.caption: Grandfather’s stolen signet ring—showing a fresh jeweler’s scratch made when the former butler resized it five years after grandfather’s passing.

nodes.text: Look at that resize scratch! It matches the exact dent in the wax seal on Helen’s "ancient" codicil—which proves the codicil was forged FIVE YEARS after grandfather died!
And the pawnshop clerk identified Helen’s former butler on the spot! The butler didn’t just steal the ring—he was the "Guardian Proxy" Helen invented!
[smuggled message via visitor] Tell that ungrateful doctor she’ll never stop the 3 PM wire—the notary already signed off at the Trust Bank!

nodes.prompt: Four hours until the Trust Bank’s 3:00 PM deadline:

options.label: Audit the notary’s bank account history
options.player_reply_text: Follow the bribe! A licensed notary wouldn’t backdate a $160M codicil without a massive hidden payout from Lucas or Helen.

options.label: Set a titanium vault trap for Lucas
options.player_reply_text: Even better—invite Lucas to the Floor 58 vault at 2:30 PM to "inspect the transfer deed" while economic police wait behind the glass!

nodes.text: Investigators just flagged an offshore transfer to the notary’s brother-in-law—paid directly from Lucas’s secret slush fund!
Oh, he’s too greedy to refuse! He’ll walk right into his own handcuffs!
Before you can finish dialing the Trust Bank, Lucas’s caller ID flashes arrogantly across your screen.
He’s calling from inside the Trust Bank lobby—he has no idea we already found grandfather’s stolen ring!

nodes.headline: The Trust Bank Bluff
nodes.teaser_text: Lucas calls to gloat that the $160M transfer clears in an hour—unaware Maya just pulled the wire receipt that will bury him.

episodes.title: Emergency Call From The Trust Bank

nodes.text: 1:15 PM · Floor 58 Study. Sunlight reflects off your grandfather’s recovered signet ring as Lucas’s smug call comes through.
[cocky laugh] "One hour left, {{player_name}}! Sign over SkyCrown’s penthouse deed now and I’ll let you keep your little medical clinic!"

nodes.transcript: [smug voicemail] "Too scared to answer? In sixty minutes the Trust Bank wires 40% of SkyCrown to my account—game over!"

nodes.text: Keep talking, Lucas. Actually, come up to the Floor 58 vault at 2:30 PM—I have a very special seal to show you before the bank signs off.
YES! The forensic accounting desk just cracked Helen’s jail-visit ledger—look at the wire receipt we just pulled!

nodes.prompt: You now hold both the stolen ring AND the notary bribe receipt:

options.label: Confront the notary with the wire receipt
options.player_reply_text: Send a copy of that bribe receipt straight to the notary’s phone—give him ten minutes to flip before police knock on his door!

options.label: Hand both proofs to the Trust Bank Chair
options.player_reply_text: Walk the stolen ring scan and wire receipt into the Trust Bank boardroom right now—let them see who tried to rob their vault!

nodes.text: He folded in ninety seconds! He’s recording a full confession right now admitting Helen and Lucas paid him to backdate the codicil!
The Trust Bank Chair is livid! He just lifted the freeze on your $400M reserve AND filed criminal fraud charges against Lucas!
The wire receipt renders cleanly across your screen—every digit spelling the end of Lucas’s delusion.
Now let’s show the notary receipt to the world—and welcome Lucas to his final visit to Floor 58.

nodes.headline: The Bribe Receipt
nodes.teaser_text: One offshore bank slip flips the corrupt notary into your star witness—and sets the stage for the titanium vault trap.

nodes.text: 1:45 PM · SkyCrown Command Suite. Maya displays the verified bank slip alongside the former butler’s arrest confirmation.

nodes.caption: Verified bribe wire: $350,000 paid from Lucas’s hidden account to the notary’s proxy two days before the forged codicil surfaced.

nodes.text: Economic police just picked up the former butler at the train station! He confessed Helen promised him a penthouse unit if he forged the codicil.
And Lucas has no idea both his butler and his notary have already flipped. He’s still riding up to Floor 58 thinking I’m surrendering.
Just stepped into the express lift, {{player_name}}. Have the penthouse keys and a pen waiting on the marble table!

nodes.prompt: Act 3 opens as the elevator numbers climb toward Floor 58:

options.label: Place the notary’s audio on the desk
options.player_reply_text: Put the tablet playing the notary’s confession right where Lucas expects to see a surrender contract.

options.label: Invite the full board to watch live
options.player_reply_text: Connect the Trust Bank auditors and SkyCrown’s senior board to the vault screen—let them witness the real Lucas with their own eyes!

nodes.text: Set! And the hidden cameras inside the vault room are streaming straight to the SkyCrown boardroom!
All twelve board members are watching live! This is going to be the cleanest takedown in SkyCrown history!
DING! The golden elevator doors slide open on Floor 58. Act 3 begins—and the trap snaps shut.
Come right in, Lucas. The notary has something he’d love to tell you.

nodes.headline: Act 3 · The Notary Flips
nodes.teaser_text: Lucas walks straight into the titanium vault expecting a $160M surrender—and hears his own notary confess on speaker.

nodes.text: 2:05 PM · SkyCrown Titanium Vault. Lucas strides in grinning, reaches for the velvet folder—and freezes as a trembling voice fills the room.

nodes.transcript: [notary’s trembling confession] "I confess! Helen and Lucas wired me $350,000 to backdate the codicil by eight years—the grandfather never signed it!"

nodes.text: WHAT?! That coward folded?! Wait—why did the titanium door behind me just click locked?!
Relax, Lucas. I just wanted to make sure you didn’t violate your bail twice by running away before the police arrive.
And say hello to the Trust Bank auditors and all twelve SkyCrown board members watching on the big screen right behind you!

nodes.prompt: Lucas’s arrogance evaporates into sheer terror:

options.label: Hold up grandfather’s recovered signet
options.player_reply_text: Recognize this gold ring, Lucas? The pawnshop clerk sends his regards—and the butler already told police everything.

options.label: Ask where Helen hid the real backup will
options.player_reply_text: Don’t beg yet, Lucas. Tell the board where your mother hid grandfather’s second biometric seal—before your prison sentence doubles.

nodes.text: No... no! My mother swore that ring could never be traced! Let me out—I’ll sign the divorce with zero claims!
I don’t know! She kept it in her private safety box—only she knows the vault number!
Suddenly, Lucas’s phone buzzes with an incoming collect call from the City Detention Center—Helen just heard the butler was arrested.
Put your mother on speaker, Lucas. It’s time to finish this thirty-year lie once and for all.

nodes.headline: The Vault Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Locked inside the penthouse vault, Lucas faces the full board—while Helen makes one final, frantic call from detention.

nodes.text: 2:22 PM · Floor 58 Titanium Vault. Lucas drops to his knees beside the marble table as sirens echo faintly from the avenue below.
{{player_name}}, remember our five years together? I was just blinded by my mother’s ambition! Tell the police to drop the forgery charges!
You told me my clinic dress was too cheap for your VIP party, tried to hand my grandfather’s tower to your mother, and bribed a notary to rob me. Save your tears.
Trust Bank auditors just verified every signature on the bribe wire—they’re revoking the codicil permanently on live video!
Wait—my phone is ringing again! It’s my mother from the detention payphone!

nodes.prompt: Helen is calling desperately from custody:

options.label: Take the phone & confront Helen directly
options.player_reply_text: Hand me that phone, Lucas. Let me ask your mother myself where she hid the rest of grandfather’s documents.

options.label: Let Lucas answer so Helen spills the box ID
options.player_reply_text: Answer it on speaker, Lucas—if she thinks she’s talking to you alone, she’ll blurt out her hidden safety box!

nodes.text: Recording active and synced straight to the court clerk! She’s about to incriminate herself live!
Clever trap! The detention line is already legally recorded by the wardens too!
The red speakerphone icon blinks as Helen’s frantic voice crackles across the silent vault.
Everyone stay silent. Let’s hear what Helen tries to hide next.

nodes.headline: Helen’s Desperate Call
nodes.teaser_text: One panicked slip on a recorded detention line exposes the last hidden chapter of the SkyCrown inheritance.

nodes.text: 2:35 PM · Floor 58 Titanium Vault. The detention center call rings through on speaker while the entire SkyCrown board listens in.
[frantic whisper] "Lucas! The butler got arrested! Burn the envelope in Harbor Bank Box 88 before {{player_name}} finds grandfather’s TRUE final codicil!"

nodes.transcript: [panicked voicemail] "Lucas, pick up! Go to Harbor Bank Box 88 and destroy grandfather’s original letter before {{player_name}} sees it!"

nodes.text: Hello, Helen. Thank you for giving the Trust Bank auditors and twelve board members the exact box number: Harbor Bank Box 88.
NO!! {{player_name}}, how are you on this line?! Hang up! Hang up right now!!

nodes.prompt: Police officers step out of the express lift right outside the vault:

options.label: Open the vault & let police arrest Lucas
options.player_reply_text: Unlock the titanium door, Maya. Lucas’s bail is officially revoked—let him join his mother.

options.label: Dispatch Maya immediately to Box 88
options.player_reply_text: Police have Lucas covered—Maya, rush with the court bailiff to Harbor Bank Box 88 right now! What did Helen hide from me for ten years?

nodes.text: Click! Steel handcuffs on Lucas’s wrists! And the judge just signed an emergency warrant to open Harbor Bank Box 88!
On my way with the court seal! In thirty minutes, your grandfather’s true final letter will be in your hands!
The heavy titanium door slides open—and Lucas is led out of SkyCrown Tower in handcuffs past the very velvet rope where he once humiliated you.
Wait for me at the boardroom, Maya. Let’s unseal Harbor Bank Box 88 together.

nodes.headline: The Real Will Unsealed
nodes.teaser_text: Inside Harbor Bank Box 88 sits a handwritten secret from your grandfather that explains why he chose YOU above everyone else.

nodes.text: 3:30 PM · SkyCrown Main Boardroom. Sunlight pours across the mahogany table as the court bailiff breaks the wax seal on Harbor Bank Box 88.
Look at this biometric seal—100% authentic! And it isn’t just a will... your grandfather left a private endowment fund worth $600M on top of SkyCrown Tower!
Listen to his handwritten note: "I hid this fund from greedy relatives so my granddaughter could finish medical school in peace—until the day she was ready to lead."
No wonder Helen was desperate to burn Box 88! The letter explicitly names Helen and Lucas as permanently disinherited with ZERO claim!
Everything he protected for me is finally home. Board members, let’s certify the final trust resolution.

nodes.prompt: All twelve board members rise in unanimous respect:

options.label: Ratify 100% sole control of SkyCrown
options.player_reply_text: Enter the biometric will into permanent registry—effective immediately, SkyCrown Group operates under zero shadow proxies.

options.label: Pledge $100M to free community clinics
options.player_reply_text: And in honor of my grandfather and my years as a clinic doctor, dedicate $100M from the new endowment to free community healthcare!

nodes.text: Signed, sealed, and registered! You are now the undisputed billionaire Chairwoman of the entire SkyCrown Empire!
The boardroom just burst into applause! SkyCrown’s brand reputation just soared to the highest mark in its history!
Across the city at the criminal courthouse, the gavel falls on the final sentencing of Helen, Lucas, and the rogue butler.
Court alert just came in—the judge threw out every single appeal. Total ruin for all three of them.

nodes.headline: Zero Bail, Total Ruin
nodes.teaser_text: Witness the final verdict on Lucas and Helen—before a golden morning crowns the true Sovereign of SkyCrown.

nodes.text: 5:00 PM · SkyCrown Rooftop Garden. Golden sunset glows across the skyline as Maya reads the court’s final docket.
Final sentences are official: Helen gets 18 years, Lucas gets 12 years for grand forgery and bribery, and the butler gets 8 years.
And your divorce decree just cleared with 100% asset separation—Lucas doesn’t get a single cent, not even the watch on his wrist.
All those years I wore simple clinic scrubs while they mocked me behind velvet ropes... I never needed their fake VIP room to know my worth.
Speaking of Floor 58—the interior team finished transforming the old VIP hall for tomorrow’s grand dedication ceremony!

nodes.prompt: Who gets the front-row VIP seats at tomorrow’s SkyCrown opening?

options.label: Invite your clinic nurses & local patients
options.player_reply_text: Reserve Floor 58’s front row for the nurses, doctors, and neighborhood families who stood by me when I was "just a clinic doctor."

options.label: Remove the velvet rope permanently
options.player_reply_text: Take down that red velvet rope on Floor 58 forever—from tomorrow on, SkyCrown welcomes merit and kindness, never snobbery!

nodes.text: Best guest list in SkyCrown history! They’re already calling to say they’ve never been invited to a penthouse before!
Already rolled up and tossed in the bin! Tomorrow’s photos are going to inspire the entire city!
You slip your grandfather’s recovered gold signet onto your hand, watching the city lights shimmer beneath your tower.
Thank you, Grandpa. Tomorrow morning, SkyCrown begins its brightest era.

nodes.headline: Tomorrow’s Golden Summit
nodes.teaser_text: One final morning celebration crowns the Sovereign of SkyCrown—with zero velvet ropes and a billion-dollar heart.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · SkyCrown Floor 58 Grand Hall. Morning sunshine floods the panoramic glass hall as doctors, philanthropists, and city leaders gather—with zero velvet ropes in sight.
Look around, Chairwoman {{player_name}}! Your old clinic nurses are toasting beside billionaire investors, and the SkyCrown Medical Foundation is officially funded!
Last week, someone laughed at my $20 dress right outside these elevator doors and told me I couldn’t afford the ice in this room.
Today, this entire floor belongs to healing, science, and dignity—and nobody will ever be judged by the price tag on their coat here again.
Wait—the Mayor just handed you the City Philanthropy Key, AND SkyCrown’s stock just opened at a record $1.8 billion valuation!

nodes.prompt: Raise your glass to seal the new era of SkyCrown Tower:

options.label: Toast to your grandfather’s legacy
options.player_reply_text: To my grandfather—who taught me that true wealth is measured by how many lives you lift up. Welcome to the new SkyCrown!

options.label: Open the rooftop observatory to the public
options.player_reply_text: And one final surprise: every Sunday, SkyCrown’s Floor 58 skyline deck opens FREE to students and families across the city!

nodes.text: A thunderous cheer shakes the glass hall! Every single guest is raising their glass to you, {{player_name}}!
Front-page magic! The whole city is already calling you the People’s Billionaire!
Sunlight crowns Floor 58 in pure gold as you gaze out over the city—unbreakable, compassionate, and victorious.
No fake VIP rooms. No velvet ropes. Just the view from the very top.

nodes.headline: Grand Finale · Sovereign Of SkyCrown
nodes.teaser_text: Helen, Lucas, and the rogue butler are behind bars, your grandfather’s hidden $600M legacy is restored, and you reign over SkyCrown with grace.
